title: ui-kirk: create compilation progress
description: Create a compilation progress component that displays real-time feedback during Kirk compilation. Shows compilation stages, current operation, time elapsed, and any warnings or errors encountered during the artifact compilation process.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display compilation progress with stage indicators
THE SYSTEM SHALL show elapsed time during compilation

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL update the progress display to show current stage details
THE SYSTEM SHALL display the warning in the progress log
THE SYSTEM SHALL show completion status with summary statistics

unwanted.condition: IF compilation produces excessive log output
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT overwhelm the UI with unfiltered logs
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT appear frozen without feedback
unwanted.because: Users need to know compilation is still active

preconditions: Progress callback must be registered with compiler
Timer must be started for elapsed time tracking
postconditions: Compilation progress is displayed in real-time
All stages are shown with completion status
Final status accurately reflects compilation result

happy: Given compilation starts, when first stage begins, then progress shows stage name and 0% complete
Given compilation in progress, when stage completes, then progress advances to next stage
Given compilation finishes, when all stages complete, then success message with statistics is shown
error: Given compilation fails at stage 2, when error occurs, then error details are displayed with retry option
Given compilation times out, when timeout occurs, then timeout message is shown
Given compilation produces warnings, when warnings occur, then they are logged but compilation continues
